notes: Background: mid-market B2B SaaS (product ops) building in-app assistant + advanced search/rerank. PLG signups, heavy weekday daytime peaks.
Trial summary (Hosted API): 30-day developer trial completed. Instrumented with SDK and basic telemetry.
Observed traffic during trial: baseline 6-10 QPS, midday peak spikes to ~22 QPS (sustained ~2-3 min bursts).
Token mix (observed): 62% short queries (<150 tokens total), 28% medium (150-600 tokens), 10% long (>600 tokens). Average tokens/request ~420 tokens.
Concurrency vs QPS: frontend concurrency measured at 1.8-2.2x QPS during peaks due to streaming and open websocket sessions (peak concurrent requests ~45 when QPS ~22).
Latency & SLO: product team target 95th pct latency <300ms for chat responses; current hosted trial median 180ms but 95th spikes to 650ms under peak bursts.
Cost sensitivity: team wants to keep hosted spend < $12k/mo during pilot; committed ARR target requires < $0.0025 per token average at scale.
Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; fallback to smaller quantized variants during degradation. Would like routing by cost vs latency.
Security: SSO/SAML mandatory for admin console access; needs audit logs and KMS integration for key management. Data residency preference: NA-only for enterprise customers.
Quote from Head of Product: 'Need predictable tail latencies — can't have chat timeouts in demos.'
POC asks: dedicated sizing worksheet, proof of canary rollout, plan for KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts, sample rollout A/B config.
